subject: Invitation to Annual Company Dinner
body: Dear Team, We are delighted to invite you to our annual company dinner on Friday, December 10th at 7:00 PM. The event will be held at the Grand Hall and will include a three-course meal, entertainment, and a raffle with exciting prizes. Please RSVP by November 30th so we can confirm numbers with the venue. We look forward to celebrating another successful year together! Best regards, [Company Name]
